title.zh: v2.1.4 两个音质门禁接进 verify；顺手清掉计划里六处过时的「未做」
title.en: v2.1.4 Two Audio Gates Wired into verify; Six Stale “Not Done” Claims Corrected

highlights.zh: **两个一直存在、一直通过、却从来不在 `verify` 里的门禁**：`check_loudness_spread.mjs`（按大类分档的响度）与 `check_timbre_spread.mjs`（159 曲风的音色指纹）此前只能靠人记得手动跑，没有 npm script。现在有 `check:loudness` / `check:timbre`，并接进 `verify`（`check:gs1` 之后、E2E 之前）。两者只读已提交的基线与源码、不启浏览器，实测 0.06 s 与 0.15 s。**「代码改了、基线没重录」从此每次发版都会被抓住。**
highlights.en: **Two gates that had always existed, always passed, and were never in `verify`**: `check_loudness_spread.mjs` (per-category loudness) and `check_timbre_spread.mjs` (the 159 genres' timbre fingerprints) could only be run by whoever remembered them — they had no npm script. Now `check:loudness` and `check:timbre` exist and sit inside `verify` (after `check:gs1`, before E2E). highlights.zh: **一次计划核对，翻出六处过时说法。** 全量响度测量其实早已跑完并写入基线（6 个类别中位数、69/159 因自身峰均比顶到上限、**159 条 trim 与报告完全一致**、0/159 削波、峰值最差 −1.242 dBTP）；音色基线也已重录，门禁还顺带断言 `src/data/genres/**` 与录音逐字节一致；「限幅器起音平滑」不是待办而是**已结案**（有前瞻时瞬时起音正是让天花板成为硬墙的做法，真正该修的每样本滑窗最小值已换成单调队列）。**手机端代码一行未动。**
highlights.en: **A plan audit turned up six stale claims.** The full loudness measurement had in fact finished and been baked into the baseline (six category medians, 69/159 capped by their own crest factor, **all 159 trims matching the report**, 0/159 clipping, worst true peak −1.242 dBTP); the timbre baseline had been re-recorded too, and that gate also asserts `src/data/genres/**` is byte-identical to the recording; and “limiter attack smoothing” is not a pending task but **closed** (wi…

highlights.zh: **同一份文档自己跟自己矛盾**：状态块写着「首屏单一动作（U1/U2）、术语表、工具栏 `?` 入口、Modal 栈仍未做」，而上面的 U 表早就记着四项都已交付（G.23/G.25/G.26、U9、G.28、G.24）。§3.5 与 §4 那份「均未开始」的清单也多数已完成（齐奏/立体声展开、键盘跟踪、立体声完整性、延迟不重建图、`toolbarTiers`、密度设置、iOS 静音无声）；**真正仍未做的只有波表与鼓组采样层（需要素材与许可）和混响 IR 移出主线程（已降级）**。
highlights.en: **The document contradicted itself**: a status block still claimed the first-screen single action (U1/U2), the glossary, the toolbar `?` entry point and the modal stack were undone, while the U table above had long recorded all four as delivered (G.23/G.25/G.26, U9, G.28, G.24).
